caption: The drawing features a rectangular section positioned centrally on a larger, off-white or light beige background. Within this section, there is a repeated vertical pattern consisting of two alternating motifs: a sailboat and an anchor. The motifs are rendered in a reddish-pink color, forming vertical stripes. Each stripe alternates between the sailboat and anchor motifs, each motif being equally spaced from one another both vertically and horizontally. Thin vertical lines in the same reddish-pink color separate each column of motifs. The entire patterned area is bordered, slightly offset from the plain background. There is a signature below the patterned section on the left side, written in a small cursive script.
title: Printed Cotton
